purpose: Registry of deterioration/exposure mechanisms available to Civil Existing Workflow. Registry presence does not authorize project use; each project must activate and parameterize a model explicitly.

models.applicability: Reinforced concrete exposed to carbonation where a square-root-time approximation is justified by the selected technical reference and project conditions.
models.units: project rule pack must declare consistent units
models.validity_range: UNSET; must be supplied by selected reference/model calibration
models.formula_family: x_c(t) = k_c * sqrt(t) with project/reference-specific modifiers

models.applicability: Only where chloride exposure is project-relevant and a validated diffusion model is selected.
models.units: project rule pack must declare consistent units

models.applicability: After an explicitly modeled or observed depassivation/corrosion initiation state.
models.units: project rule pack must declare consistent units
models.solver_effect: May generate scenario-specific longitudinal/stirrup effective steel area only through Structural Property Adapter

models.applicability: RC members where corrosion expansion or other applicable deterioration can produce cover cracking/spalling.
models.units: project rule pack must declare consistent units
models.solver_effect: Feeds bond/section/confined-core scenario adapters only when explicitly activated

models.applicability: Only where corrosion/damage and anchorage-sensitive behavior justify explicit bond degradation modeling.
models.units: project rule pack must declare consistent units
models.solver_effect: Optional nonlinear/interface adapter; never an automatic stiffness reduction
